input.query:
SELECT
  c.id AS customer_id,
  c.name AS customer_name,
  o.id AS order_id,
  o.status AS order_status,
  o.order_date,
  p.name AS product_name,
  p.sku,
  oi.id AS order_item_id,
  oi.quantity,
  oi.unit_price_cents,
  r.id AS refund_id,
  r.status AS refund_status,
  r.reason AS refund_reason,
  r.amount_cents,
  r.requested_at,
  r.evidence_submitted
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN refunds r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id
WHERE c.name ILIKE 'Ava Thompson'
  AND p.name ILIKE '%Bluetooth Headphones%'
input.intent: Find the refund record for Ava Thompson's Bluetooth Headphones order to verify details before any approval decision.

output.sql_executed: SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, o.id AS order_id, o.status AS order_status, o.order_date, p.name AS product_name, p.sku, oi.id AS order_item_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price_cents, r.id AS refund_id, r.status AS refund_status, r.reason AS refund_reason, r.amount_cents, r.requested_at, r.evidence_submitted FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE c.name ILIKE 'Ava Thompson' AND p.name ILIKE '%Bluetooth Headphones%' LIMIT 500

input.query: defective product refund approval requirements evidence

output.content:
Damaged in Shipping

Items returned under the `damaged_shipping` reason code have no time limit for return. A refund request under the `damaged_shipping` reason code requires supporting photo evidence before the refund can be processed.

Evidence is tracked structurally as `refunds.evidence_submitted` (boolean) — this confirms evidence was provided, not that the evidence is valid; validity review is a manual/out-of-scope step for Part 1.

Defective Items

Items returned under the `defective` reason code may be refunded up to 90 days from the purchase date. The 90-day window for a `defective` refund applies regardless of the standard 30-day return window, and takes precedence over the standard 30-day return window when the two conflict.

Approval Threshold

A refund with an amount greater than $200 requires manager approval before the refund can be processed. The $200 approval threshold applies regardless of the refund's reason code.
